title: Backfill process and timeline
summary: I signed up for Premium Archive/Pro. The archive backfill for one of my feeds (Deadline) appears incomplete. Is there a timeline on when the backfill becomes fully present in my account?
body_markdown:
[Hexelmik](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/Hexelmik)


September 3, 2026, 3:24am 1


I signed up for Premium Archive/Pro. The archive backfill for one of my feeds (Deadline) appears incomplete. Is there a timeline on when the backfill becomes fully present in my account?


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


September 3, 2026, 5:01am 2


You should receive an email when it’s finished but it usually takes no more than a few hours. Do you have a link to the feed that needs it’s backfill? Not every feed gets a backfill, some feeds just don’t support it. NewsBlur tries hard to find every story but it doesn’t always work.
